title.narrative: "Strengthening Networking & Knowledge Sharing Between ""ASEAN Plus"" Judicial & Legal Institutions"

description.narrative: " This proposal responds to a request from H.E. Hilario J. Davide, Jr., Chief Justice of the Supreme Court of the Philippines, and his companion justices, to provide institution-building technical assistance to the Supreme Court of the Philippines for it to establish and coordinate an ASEAN-wide Network of Supreme Courts and legal institutions. Justice Davide, who has envisioned and led the judicial reform initiative in the Philippines, will personally lead this regional initiative. The Grant objective is to strengthen regional collaboration on judicial reform by establishing a Knowledge Network to facilitate knowledge-sharing and management between ""ASEAN Plus"" higher judicial and legal institutions (ASEAN Plus refers to the fact that Mongolia will be a part of this network, to which the ASEAN countries have agreed). The Knowledge Network will focus on: (a) sharing lessons on designing and implementing judicial reforms, (b) strengthening judicial independence, (c) facilitating judicial strengthening across ASEAN members, and (d) facilitating judicial and legal consensus on approaches to adjudicating transnational/cross-border economic and trade issues. The Network will achieve this by establishing knowledge-sharing and knowledge management mechanisms between ASEAN higher judicial and legal institutions. Such a Network would also complement donor and ASEAN government initiatives to support legal and judicial reform, and could also contribute to reducing trade barriers and harmonizing judicial approaches to cross-border trade and commerce between ASEAN member countries.
